name: Context
description: Defines and provides context@1: persona file loading, preamble, context build, and the view_image, session_search, session_view and skill_read tools.

compactionThreshold.title: Compaction threshold
compactionThreshold.description: Fraction of the model's context window (0-1) that triggers trimming and compaction.

personaMaxBytesPerFile.title: Persona byte cap
personaMaxBytesPerFile.description: Max bytes read per persona file when the project doesn't set maxBytesPerFile.

autoNameSessions.title: Name sessions automatically
autoNameSessions.description: After a session's first reply, title it with the provider's Utility model (set in the provider's own settings).

skillsEnabled.title: Skills
skillsEnabled.description: List skills (<workspace>/skills and ~/.valet/skills, SKILL.md files) in the preamble and offer skill_read. A project's settings.skills can turn them off or change the folders.
